blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hyperspectral images (HSI) possess discriminating spectral characteristics with respect to land utilization due to high-dimensional information. Recently, unsupervised representation learning using graph neural networks has unveiled these utilization-specific complex spectral relations. This article has three main contributions. First, it proposes an index, the Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index (MALNISI), which measures the similarity between two pixels based on their neighborhood information. The index is used to construct a weighted adjacency matrix, giving the HSI a graph structure. Second, it proposes an upgraded Graph Attention Network that learns compact latent representations of hyperspectral data from the constructed graph. In this network, an enhanced multi-head attention mechanism incorporates the MALNISI weights as an auxiliary feature to emphasize learned attention between neighboring pixels. To alleviate over-smoothing and preserve fine-grained spectral details, the architecture integrates residual connections, skip projections, and feature normalization, which together enhance representation capability, stabilize learning, and accelerate convergence. Third, it proposes a weighted contrastive loss function that incorporates neighborhood-aware MALNISI between connected pixels, encouraging strongly connected pixels in the high-dimensional space to remain close in the latent space, and weakly connected pixels to stay apart. The resulting discriminative low-dimensional embeddings are then clustered using spectral clustering. Experimental analysis on six benchmark HSI datasets demonstrates the efficiency and necessity of the three aforementioned contributions, and the comparative study highlights superior performance over fourteen state-of-the-art approaches.
blocks.zh: 超光谱图象(HSI)由于高维度信息,在土地利用方面具有不同的光谱特征。 最近,利用图神经网络进行的无监督的表达学习揭示了这些与利用相关的复杂光谱关系。 本条有三个主要贡献。 首先,它提出了一个指数,即"平均绝对局部邻里反光谱指数"(MALNISI),根据邻里信息来测量两个像素之间的相似性. 该指数用于构建一个加权的辅音矩阵,给HSI一个图表结构. 第二,它提议建立一个升级后的图表关注网络,从构建的图表中学习超光谱数据的紧凑潜在表示。 在这个网络中,一个增强的多头关注机制将MALNISI的权重作为辅助功能,强调邻居像素之间学到的注意. 为了缓解过度疏松和保存精细的光谱细节,该架构整合了剩余连接,跳过预测,并具有特征的正常化,这些都共同提高了表达能力,稳定了学习,加速了趋同. 第三,它提出一个加权对比性丢失函数,在连接像素之间纳入邻里感知的MALNISI,鼓励高维空间中紧密连接的像素在潜在空间中保持紧密,弱连接的像素保持隔离. 由此产生的差别低维嵌入物再利用光谱集群进行集群. 对六套基准HSI数据集的实验分析表明上述三项贡献的效率和必要性,比较研究突出了超过十四项最新办法的优异业绩。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Hyperspectral images (HSI) [ 1 ] have rich spectral information, which enables accurate discrimination of different land-use and land-cover (LULC) materials. This discriminating nature must be learnt by unveiling complex inter-spectral correlations among the pixels. Unsupervised segmentation of LULC [ 1 ] focuses on partitioning the HSI into meaningful groups of pixels and addresses the combination of high-dimensional data with complex inter-spectral correlations. For unsupervised segmentation, graph-based learning methods, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), have emerged as powerful tools in recent years for hyperspectral image analysis [ 2 ] . By representing pixels as nodes and similarity relationships as edges, graphs provide a natural framework for modelling the intrinsic structure of hyperspectral data [ 2 ] . In particular, graphs used in GNNs [ 3 , 4 ] effectively capture both local and non-local dependencies—unlike feature maps in CNNs [ 5 ] , which are limited by fixed local receptive fields. This nature of learning is crucial for HSI data, where spectrally similar pixels may be spatially distant, and by leveraging graph connectivity, GNNs can effectively propagate information among such spectrally similar yet spatially distant pixels, enabling more robust representation learning for hyperspectral analysis.

blocks.en: While GNNs are powerful in the context of HSI analysis, their effectiveness largely depends on the initial graph construction. Simple Euclidean-based adjacency fails to capture the non-linear manifold of hyperspectral data [ 6 ] . Traditional spectral measures such as Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM) [ 7 ] and Spectral Information Divergence (SID) [ 8 ] rely on pointwise comparisons, ignoring spatial context and remaining sensitive to noise and intra-class variability, often producing salt-and-pepper artifacts. Spatial–spectral methods like the Multiscale Spatial-Spectral Preprocessing Framework (MSSPF) [ 9 ] incorporate local context but are computationally expensive due to patch-wise comparisons, while graph-regularization approaches using mutual nearest neighbor (MNN) [ 10 ] require memory-intensive k k -NN graphs. Anchor-based learning methods [ 11 , 12 ] are also highly sensitive to initial anchor selection and often highly sensitive to noise. These limitations highlight the need for graph construction strategies that can efficiently model local and global spatial relationships while preserving fine-grained spectral characteristics. Graph construction [ 2 ] primarily depends on predefined similarity measures and superpixel segmentation, which may not fully capture fine-grained spectral differences between neighboring pixels, especially in regions with high spectral variability.
blocks.zh: 虽然GNN在HSI分析中是强大的,但其有效性主要取决于初始图构建. 简单的以欧几利得为基的相位无法捕捉到超光谱数据的非线性多相 [6]. 传统的光谱度量,如光谱角映射仪(SAM)[7]和光谱信息分辨仪(SID)[8]依靠点入相比较,忽略了空间上下文,对噪音和类内可变性保持敏感,常出产盐相相相相通的文物. 空间-光谱方法,如多尺度空间-分层预处理框架[9]包含局部上下文,但因补丁比较而计算成本昂贵,而使用相邻相邻(MNN)[10]的图态规范方法则需要内存密集克-NN图. 基于Anchor的学习方法[11,12]对初始锚选择也高度敏感,并经常对噪声高度敏感. 这些局限性突出表明,需要制定能有效模拟当地和全球空间关系的图表构建战略,同时保持精细的光谱特征。 图形构造[2]主要依赖于预先定义的相似度测量和超像素分化,它们可能无法完全捕捉到相邻像素之间的细微分光谱差异,特别是在光谱可变性高的地区.

blocks.en: In this article, a Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index (MALNISI) is proposed as the first contribution, focusing on the structural consistency between a pixel pair relative to a shared, localized neighborhood to capture contextual consistency-based spectral similarity rather than point-to-point spectral similarity. The absolute differences in spectral distance of both the points are taken with respect to every point in the common neighborhood, and then the inverse average score represents the proposed similarity index. The inverse function helps in bounding the index in ( 0 , 1 ] (0,1] . The index rewards pairs that maintain a stable spectral relationship with their surroundings by evaluating how two pixels see their shared neighborhood.

blocks.en: The proposed index considers the union of individual neighborhoods which becomes more robust to noise, illumination variability, and minor spectral distortions that often affect individual pixel values. Here, neighborhood-level aggregation acts as a form of spatial smoothing, reducing the influence of random noise, while the use of relative comparisons within the neighborhood mitigates the effect of global illumination changes. Moreover, the use of absolute differences further enhances robustness by reducing the influence of local spectral distortions. The emphasis on local spectral consistency helps preserve structural patterns such as edges and textures, with tolerance for spatial misalignments.
blocks.zh: 拟议的指数考虑了个别街区的结合,这些街区变得更强壮到噪音,发光变异,以及往往会影响个别像素值的微小光谱扭曲. 在这里,邻里级聚合起到空间平滑的一种作用,会减少随机噪声的影响,而邻里内部相对比较的使用会减轻全球发光变化的影响. 此外,使用绝对差异通过减少局部光谱扭曲的影响来进一步提高稳健性. 强调局部光谱一致性有助于保存边缘和纹理等结构规律,能容忍空间错配.

blocks.en: The MALNISI index is well-suited for constructing a weighted graph for HSI with 4 4 -neighborhood pixels as adjacent nodes inspired by graph-regularization approaches [ 10 ] . Additionally, the pixels from the same LULC maintain consistent spectral properties with their neighbors, but at boundaries, this consistency breaks, producing weaker similarity. MALNISI reflects this trait and generates context-aware weighted graphs, leading to better preservation of LULC structures, which helps in improving clustering performance.
blocks.zh: MARNISI指数非常适合为HSI构建一个加权图,以4个相邻的相邻像素为相邻的节点,受图-正态化方法的启发[10]. 此外,来自同一种LULC的像素保持了与其相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相接的光谱特性,但是在边界上,这种一致性会断裂,产生较弱的相似性. MARNISI反映了这种特性并生成了上下文感的加权图,从而更好地保存了LULC结构,这有助于提高集群性能.

blocks.en: Graph Attention Networks (GATs) [ 13 ] among GNN architectures, are well-suited for lower-dimensional representation of graph nodes, as they can adaptively assign attention weights to neighboring nodes and selectively emphasize relationships between them. The second contribution of the work lies in the proposed MALNISI-guided upgraded GAT architecture, which exploits weighted graph information during attention computation, unlike conventional GATs. For this, the MALNISI edge weights are incorporated as auxiliary features to prevent their dilution, and, secondly, during attention score learning, they reweight the attention coefficients to guide learning. In addition, the proposed architecture employs multi-head attention to capture diverse neighborhood interactions and incorporates residual connections, skip projections, and feature normalization to alleviate over-smoothing and stabilize deep graph representation learning.
blocks.zh: 在GNN架构中,Graph Region Networks(GATs)[13]非常适合图节点的下维表示,因为它们可以适应性地给相邻的节点分配注意力分量并有选择地强调它们之间的关系. 这项工作的第二个贡献在于拟议的由MALNISI制导的升级GAT架构,该架构在注意力计算时利用了加权图信息,与常规GAT不同. 为此,MARNISI边重被作为辅助特征被收录来防止其被稀释;第二,在注意力分数学习过程中,它们重新加权注意系数来指导学习. 此外,拟议架构利用多头关注来捕捉不同的邻里互动,并纳入剩余连接,跳过预测,并展现正常化特征来缓解过度平稳和稳定深层图表表现学习.

blocks.en: Unlike conventional methods that reconstruct only binary adjacency, the proposed weighted contrastive loss utilizes MALNISI-derived adjacency weights to preserve the relative manifold structure, ensuring that the pairwise relationships encoded in the high-dimensional space are faithfully retained in the low-dimensional embedding. This third contribution encourages strongly connected node pairs to remain close in the latent space while pushing negative pairs apart, leading to more discriminative low-dimensional representations. Besides, incorporating MALNISI weights into the positive-pair similarity term introduces neighborhood awareness absent in conventional contrastive loss.
blocks.zh: 与仅重建二元相接力的常规方法不同,所拟议的加权对比性损失利用了MALNISI所衍生的相接力权重来保存相对多面结构,确保高维空间所编码的对等关系被忠实地保留入低维嵌入. 第三个贡献鼓励紧密相接的节点对在潜在空间保持相近,同时将负对相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 此外,将MARNISI的权重纳入正-平相似性术语,引入了传统对比性损失中不存在的街区意识。

blocks.en: Following dimensionality reduction, the learned latent embeddings from the MALNISI-GAT network are clustered to yield the final segmentation map. This is performed using spectral clustering (SC) [ 14 ] , which has consistently shown strong performance for HSI analysis [ 2 ] . Thus, the main contributions of this work can be summarized as follows: • A similarity index, MALNISI ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] \in(0,1] that captures spectral similarity between two points considering common neighborhoods to put emphasis on local consistency. • A MALNISI-guided Graph Attention Network (GAT) for robust nonlinear dimensionality reduction with upgraded attention mechanism to incorporate MALNISI as an auxiliary feature to prevent the loss of edge weights. • A novel weighted contrastive loss that integrates cosine similarity with MALNISI score for incorporating neighborhood awareness and better latent space separability.

Section III and IV present the proposed MALNISI index and the proposed GAT architecture. Section V reports experimental performance and comparative study, and conclusive remarks are given in Section VI .

blocks.en: In earlier HSI clustering, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) [ 15 ] and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) [ 16 ] were used for lower-dimensional representation prior to partitioning. Manifold learning [ 17 ] introduced non-linear HSI data handling with noise sensitivity and high costs. When pixels were treated as separate entities during partitioning, Fuzzy C C -Means (FCM) [ 18 ] and K K -means [ 19 ] were unable to handle high spectral variability and non-spherical distributions. Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) [ 20 ] and Clustering by Fast Search and Finding of Density Peaks (CFSFDP) [ 21 ] identified arbitrary shapes but struggled with the curse of dimensionality. Graph-based frameworks like the Bipartite Graph-based Projected Clustering (BGPC) [ 11 ] and Structured Anchor Projected Clustering (SAPC) [ 12 ] address these limitations with non-neighboring pixel connectivity, anchor-pixel relationships, and Laplacian rank constraints. Fast Spectral Clustering with Anchor Graph (FSCAG) [ 22 ] and Scalable Graph-based Clustering with Nonnegative Relaxation (SGCNR) [ 4 ] also address these by employing sparse anchor graphs and nonnegative relaxation to maintain linear complexity.
blocks.zh: 在早先的HSI集群中,主要组件分析(PCA)[15]和线性差别分析(LDA)[16]被用于分解前的下维表示. Manifold学习[17]引入了非线性HSI数据处理,具有噪声敏感性和高成本. 当像素在分出过程中被作为单独的实体处理时,Fuzzy C-Means(FCM)[18]和K-means[19]无法处理高光谱可变性和非球面分布. 以密度为基础的空间组合应用与噪声(DBSCAN)[20]和以快速搜索和发现密度峰(CFSFDP)[21]组成的组合确定了任意形状,但与维度的诅咒相搏。 基于图表的框架,如基于双方图的预测集群[11]和结构化的Anchor预测集群[12],以非邻接像素连通性、锚-像素关系和拉普拉斯排名限制来解决这些局限性。 以Anchor Graph(FSCAG)[22]和以可缩放图形为基础的以非负式放松(SGCNR)[4]为对象的快速光谱集聚也通过使用稀疏的锚地图和非负式放松来保持线性复杂性来解决这些问题.

blocks.en: Subspace clustering improves segmentation by assuming pixels of the same class lie within low-dimensional subspaces. Sparse Subspace Clustering-BP (SSC-BP) [ 23 ] , Elastic Net Subspace Clustering (EnSC) [ 24 ] and Hierarchical Sparse Subspace Clustering (HESSC) [ 25 ] leverage self-expressiveness to reconstruct target pixels from a sparse linear combination of the HSI dictionary. Superpixel-level Global and Local Similarity-based Clustering (SGLSC) [ 26 ] and Elastic Graph Fusion Subspace Clustering (EGFSC) [ 2 ] utilize a dual-graph fusion strategy to merge spatial superpixel and spectral band relationships into a unified latent representation.

blocks.en: Modern advancements like Non-local Contrastive Subspace Clustering (NCSC) [ 27 ] introduce deep subspace clustering via a superpixel pooling autoencoder and neighborhood contrastive regularization, which attract spatial neighbors while repelling dissimilar samples in a contracted latent space. Deep Spectral Clustering Feature Selection (DSCFS) [ 28 ] also combines deep learning-based HSI representation with adaptive feature projection and extracts key features. Concurrently, deep representation learning [ 29 ] based methods like Deep Clustering Network (DCN) [ 30 ] utilize Autoencoders (AE) [ 31 ] and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) [ 32 ] to capture intricate nonlinearities, while their success relies on the integration of feature-learning backbones and clustering objectives.

blocks.en: Recent research has pivoted toward hybrid frameworks to synthesize these disparate strengths. Deep Spectral Clustering with Regularized Linear Embedding (DSCRLE) [ 33 ] combines regularized linear embedding from deep networks with a graph Laplacian matrix obtained from anchor graph construction and solves out-of-sample problems. Scalability and noise robustness are emphasized in Spectral-Spatial Sparse Anchor Graph Clustering (S 3 AGC) [ 34 ] , which employs superpixel-based denoising and band-based graph convolutions. Despite these advancements, existing frameworks often rely on static kernels, suffer from sampling bias, or push apart pixels that are spectrally similar but not spatially adjacent. To address these limitations, the proposed methodology uses a GAT for attention-based relationship learning and transitive feature aggregation via multi-hop message passing. By integrating the MALNISI index for noise-robust spectral guidance and keeping the same notion in latent space through a weighted contrastive loss function, the framework ensures improved performance. A comprehensive summary of state-of-the-art (SOTA) and contrasting improvements are presented in Tables I and II .

blocks.en: B. Motivation & Intuition: Spectral Clustering (SC) is highly effective in HSI clustering, as it captures the complex, non-linear distribution of hyperspectral data [ 2 ] . However, SC is computationally expensive with O ⁡ ( N 3 ) O(N^{3}) , as pairwise similarity is calculated, and is also susceptible to the “curse of dimensionality”. Due to this, formation of an ineffective adjacency matrix 𝐀 \mathbf{A} leads to poor clustering and LULC boundary identification. To enhance the efficacy of SC, it is prudent to perform dimensionality reduction with structural separability. Feature selection approaches are less suitable here, as they lose information, and extraction methods [ 17 ] including PCA, Isomap, Locally Linear Embedding (LLE), and Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP), are not fully suitable as they are confined to non-linear structural preservation. On the other hand, GAT are capable of not only addressing these issues but also have spectral discrimination with a compact latent space projection [ 35 ] . In GAT, though, adjacency is established only among neighboring nodes, but information from distant neighbors is propagated through message-passing mechanisms [ 36 ] .

This observation motivates the integration of spatial context into the proposed architecture. To achieve this, the proposed framework leverages both the advantage of the message passing in GAT and incorporates localized spatial context by utilizing the immediate neighbors of each pixel as the neighborhood function within the MALNISI computation.

blocks.en: The primary objective of this framework is to inject the relative importance of neighboring pixels for individual pixels in GAT learning. To achieve this, MALNISI-based weights are incorporated in two ways: first, as feature attributes to enrich the input representation; and second, to re-emphasize the learned attention coefficients according to the MALNISI values. Multi-head attention is employed in the network to capture different views from the same neighborhood, thereby producing richer feature representations. However, in the final layer, single-head attention is utilized to satisfy the user-defined latent space dimensionality requirement.
blocks.zh: 这个框架的首要目标是在GAT学习中注入相邻像素对单个像素的相对重要性. 为了实现这一点,基于MALNISI的权重通过两种方式进行整合:第一,作为特征属性来丰富输入表达;第二,根据MALNISI值重新强调所学到的注意系数. 网络中采用多头关注来捕捉来自同个街区的不同观点,从而产生更丰富的特征表述. 然而,在最后一层,单头注意力被用来满足用户定义的潜在空间维度要求。

blocks.en: Despite its effectiveness, repeated neighborhood aggregation during message passing in GAT may cause intrinsically dissimilar nodes to develop highly similar representations, leading to an over-smoothing effect. Layer normalization applied after each attention layer to rescale the node representations, which improves embedding compactness, cluster separability, and mitigates the effect. The Leaky ReLU activation function [ 37 ] introduces non-linearity into the network, enabling it to learn complex relationships. Additionally, dropout serves as a regularization mechanism by randomly deactivating a subset of feature dimensions and attention coefficients during training, thereby reducing overfitting. Apart from this, residual connections via linear transformation layers help mitigate the over-smoothing problem by appending lower-level discriminating features.
blocks.zh: 尽管它很有效,但在GAT中传递消息时重复的邻里汇总可能会造成内在的不相似的节点来发展出高度相近的表示,从而导致过度平缓的效果. 层常态在每一关注层后应用来调整节点表示的大小,这可以改善嵌入紧凑性,组分性,并减轻影响. Leaky ReLU活化功能[37]将非线性引入了网络,使其能够学习复杂的关系. 此外,辍学作为一种正规化机制,在培训期间随机去除一部分特征层面和关注系数,从而减少过度调整。 除此之外,通过线性转换层的剩余连接通过附加较低层次的区别特征来帮助缓解过度舒缓的问题.

blocks.en: 2) Proposed Weighted Contrastive Loss: GAT does not explicitly enforce discriminative representations in the embeddings, and therefore, to enforce discrimination, contrastive loss [ 35 ] is incorporated. To achieve discrimination, if u u and v v are two pixels from the same region, then they are to be embedded very closely (high A i ​ j A_{ij} ); and the separation grows when they belong to different regions (low A i ​ j A_{ij} ). blocks.en: Table V and Table VI show the qualitative and quantitative performance, respectively, of the proposed framework and are analyzed simultaneously in this section. OA and AA provide insight into category-wise balance in performance, and for IndianP and HongHu, the gap is 23 23 % and 22 22 %, respectively, due to LULC imbalance. The smaller regions belonging to clusters 1 − 4 1-4 , 10 − 12 10-12 , and 15 − 16 15-16 of IndianP became part of spectrally similar neighboring bigger regions in the latent space, which reduces AA. For HongHu, the embeddings of different categories are not sufficiently well separated in the latent space, which exacerbates the situation and makes smaller clusters (e.g., clusters 8 8 and 14 14 ) merge with larger clusters. With partial bias toward dominant categories and misidentification of minority clusters 4 4 and 7 7 , for PaviaU, the gap is 16 16 %. Due to lower LULC imbalance, Botswana and KSC have a relatively small gap ( 6 6 %). The situation reverses for Salinas, where smaller cluster regions are preserved well, but larger clusters ( 8 8 and 15 15 ) have high intra-cluster variability and lower separability.
blocks.zh: 表五和表六分别显示拟议框架的质量和数量执行情况,并在本节同时分析。 OA和AA对绩效的分类平衡提供了深刻的见解,而对于IndianP和HongHu来说,由于LULC的不平衡,差距分别为23%和22%. 属于第1至4个1至4个、第10至12个10至12个以及第15至16个15至16个印度P组的较小区域成为了潜在空间中相邻较大区域的一部分,从而减少了AA。 对洪虎来说,不同类别的嵌入在潜入空间中并没有充分很好的分离,这加剧了情况并使得更小的集群(如第8,8和14,14个集群)与更大的集群合并. 对PaviaU来说,由于部分偏重于主导类别,并错误地认定了第4和第7类少数群体,差距为16%。 由于LULC的不平衡程度较低,博茨瓦纳和KSC的差距相对较小(6%)。 萨利纳斯的情况出现逆转,较小的集群区域得到很好的保存,但较大的集群(8个8个和15个15个)具有高的集群内部可变性和较低的可分性.

blocks.en: Proposed work achieves identical NMI and AMI values across all datasets, indicating statistically reliable clustering performance with minimal chance agreement. Whereas significantly high FMI and ARI values signify that pixels from the same cluster remain together and those from different clusters are separated with respect to GT. From Table VI it can be observed that for PaviaU and KSC, NMI and ARI are almost similar, indicating balanced semantic preservation and pairwise consistency, which is also evident from the comparative visualizations in 3 3 -rd and 4 4 -th columns of Table V for the respective datasets. For IndianP and Botswana, the separation between NMI and ARI comparatively increases, as the visualizations show some clusters (i.e., 5 5 , 10 10 , and 12 12 both in Botswana and IndianP GT) have merged with nearby clusters in predicted segmentations. Due to boundary ambiguity between clusters 8 8 and 15 15 the NMI and ARI differ significantly for Salinas. For HongHu, although semantic information and category distributions are preserved, the boundary separation is much less in latent space, so the NMI is lower than ARI.
blocks.zh: 拟议的工作在所有数据集中实现相同的NMI值和AMI值,表明统计上可靠的集群性能,而且机会协议很少。 相当高的FMI值和ARI值表明,同一组的像素保持在一起,不同组的像素在GT方面分离出来。 从表六可以看出,对于PaviaU和KSC来说,NMI和ARI几乎是相似的,表明平衡的语义保存和对等一致性,从表五中表三至四至四列各数据集的比较可视化也可以看出这一点。 对IndianP和博茨瓦纳来说,NMI和ARI的分离相对增加,因为可视化显示一些集群(即5个5个,10个10个,博茨瓦纳和IndianP GT的12个12个)与相邻的集群在预测分化中合并. 由于第8和15个集群之间的边界模糊,萨利纳斯的NMI和ARI差别很大。 对于HongHu来说,虽然语义信息和分类分布得到保存,但分界在潜在空间中却少得多,因此NMI比ARI还低.

blocks.en: For all datasets, homogeneity is lower than completeness, which indicates same-class samples stay together, but clusters may contain mixed classes. This behavior is desirable in HSI segmentation, where maintaining semantic continuity is often preferred over highly fragmented yet pure clusters. The kappa score for PaviaU and Salinas is higher than the others due to higher homogeneity and completeness. For other datasets, either one of them or both drop and reduce the Kappa score. Purity generally follows the trend of homogeneity since both reward intra-cluster consistency, but if smaller clusters (like the cluster 8 8 in Salinas) are included in a bigger cluster, then purity drops. Homogeneity is higher than completeness in KSC as clusters 7 7 and 9 9 , 3 3 and 10 10 , 9 9 and 10 10 collapse.
blocks.zh: 对所有数据集来说,同质性低于完整性,这表明同级样本保持在一起,但集群可能包含混合类. 这种行为在HSI分解中是可取的,在分解中,保持语义连续性往往比高度零散而纯的集群更受青睐. 帕维亚U和萨利纳斯的卡帕分数由于同分性和完整性较高而高于其他. 对于其他数据集,要么其中一个,要么两个都下降并降低卡帕分数. 纯度一般遵循同质性的趋势,因为两者都奖励集群内部的一致性,但如果将更小的集群(如萨利纳斯第8集群)包含在更大的集群中,纯度会下降. 在KSC中,同质性高于完整性,因为第7和9、9、3和10、10、9、9和10个星团崩溃。

blocks.en: Internal clustering metrics provide insight into the structure of the learned latent space. Lower DB values and higher SH scores for Salinas and KSC indicate compact, well-separated clusters, reflecting a well-organized embedding space. Although Salinas exhibits the strongest overall cluster organization, its relatively low Dunn index suggests localized overlap between a small number of cluster pairs (e.g., clusters 8 8 and 14 14 ). IndianP is characterized by high DB, low SH, and moderate CH, indicating moderate inter-class overlap despite the formation of distinct clusters. For PaviaU, low DB and SH combined with high CH and Dunn suggest strong global cluster separation, although some local overlap persists, consistent with the external evaluation metrics. In contrast, HongHu exhibits high DB, low SH, and extremely high CH, indicating large between-cluster variance but poor local separation, with substantial overlap near cluster boundaries. Botswana demonstrates balanced clustering characteristics, with moderate DB, comparatively higher SH than IndianP and PaviaU, and lower CH, suggesting reasonably compact clusters with moderate global separation. Finally, all datasets except HongHu (for which the Dunn index could not be computed because of the computational cost of pairwise distance calculations) exhibit relatively low Dunn values, indicating that while the learned embedding space preserves overall semantic structure, localized overlap remains at a few class boundaries.
blocks.zh: 内部集群衡量标准提供了对所学到的潜在空间结构的洞察。 萨利纳斯和KSC的更低的DB值和更高的SH分数表示紧凑,分离良好的集群,反映了一个组织良好的嵌入空间. 虽然萨利纳斯表现出了最强的整体集群组织,但其相对较低的邓恩指数表明少数集群对(如集群8和14 14)之间的局部重叠. 印地安人P的特点是DB高,SH低和CH中度,表明尽管形成了不同的集群,但类别间重叠程度中等. 就PaviaU而言,低DB和SH与高CH和Dunn加在一起表明,虽然一些局部重叠依然存在,但与外部评价指标一致。 相形之下,HongHu表现出了高DB,低SH,和极高的CH,表明集群之间的差异很大,但局部分离差,在集群边界附近有大量重叠. 博茨瓦纳显示出平衡的集群特征,其DB中等,SH比IndianP和PaviaU较高,CH较低,这表明全球分化程度中等的有合理紧凑的集群。 最后,除了HongHu(Dunn指数由于对等距离计算计算计算的成本而无法计算)之外,所有数据集都显示出相对较低的Dunn值,这表明虽然所学的嵌入空间保留了整体语义结构,但局部重叠仍然停留在少数类边界.

The significant improvements in AA ( 3 3 %, 18 18 %, 25 25 %, and 17 17 %) and kappa ( 18 18 %, 22 22 %, − 0.5 -0.5 %, 13 13 %), which assess the performance for every category without bias, show the discrimination capability. The high NMI and low standard deviation (SD) for all datasets indicate that the achieved segmentation has better agreement with GT categories and is stable.

blocks.en: C. Impact of Other Similarity Indices on Segmentation: This study evaluates the importance of the proposed MALNISI similarity measure by replacing it with alternative metrics, like Minkowski [ 46 ] , SAM, SID, Dice [ 47 ] , Mahalanobis distance [ 48 ] , Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) [ 49 ] , and Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) [ 49 ] , while preserving the remaining architecture. MALNISI demonstrates consistently strong and stable performance across IndianP and KSC, where MALNISI achieves substantially larger radar coverage in comparison to alternative similarity measures. For PaviaU, MALNISI provides measurable improvements across all the metrics ( ∼ 4 \sim 4 % improvement in NMI). In the HongHu dataset, all similarity measures, except Mahalanobis, which achieves the highest AA, attain nearly identical results. For the Salinas dataset, all similarity measures yield nearly identical performance. This behavior is primarily due to its high spectral separability and large homogeneous regions ( 2 2 -nd column of Table V ), which diminish the need for specialized graph-weighting strategies. In Botswana, SAM and Dice outperform MALNISI on certain metrics, implying that scale-invariant angular similarity and structural overlap measure better align with the sparse characteristics of this dataset. The comparatively weaker performance of Minkowski, SID, SSIM, and SIFT across several datasets further highlights the importance of selecting a graph metric suitable for HSI.
blocks.zh: C. 其他类似指标对分块的影响: 本研究评价了拟议的MALNISI相似性计量的重要性,取而代之的是替代度量衡,如Minkowski [46], SAM, SID, Dice [47], Mahalanobis距离 [48],结构相似性指数计量(SSIM) [49], 和比例不常变变变换(SIFT) [49],同时保留了所剩的架构. MARNISI表明,印度石油公司和KSC公司的业绩始终强劲而稳定,与替代相似性措施相比,MARNISI的雷达覆盖面要大得多。 对PaviaU来说,马里国家工业与安全研究所在所有衡量标准上提供了可衡量的改进(国家工业与安全研究所的改进率为4正4%)。 在HongHu数据集中,除了实现最高AA的Mahalanobis之外,所有类似度量衡都取得了几乎相同的结果. 就萨利纳斯数据集而言,所有相似度测量都产生几乎相同的性能. 这种行为主要是因为其高光谱可分性和大同质区(表五的2-第2列),从而减少了对专用图加权策略的需求. 在博茨瓦纳,SAM和Dice在某些度量标准上的表现优于MALNISI,这意味着尺度-变量角相近和结构重叠度量更能与本数据集的稀有特征相适应。 Minkowski、SID、SSIM和SIFT在几个数据集中的表现相对薄弱,这进一步突出了选择一个适合HSI的图表衡量标准的重要性。

blocks.en: D. Impact of different loss functions: The contribution of the proposed Weighted Contrastive Loss (WCL) is examined against standard Contrastive Loss (CL), Reconstruction Loss, Triplet Loss, Laplacian Total Variation Loss, and Orthogonal Loss. The improvement on using WCL is evident in IndianP, PaviaU and HongHu, where it achieves larger radar coverage across all metrics (except AA in IndianP). Standard CL exhibits comparatively lower performance, indicating that unweighted positive pair treatment may overlook local neighborhood reliability and introduce weaker embedding consistency. Other losses perform worse, suggesting that preserving reconstruction fidelity or enforcing pairwise margins alone is insufficient to capture complex nonlinear manifold structures in HSI data. For Salinas, all methods achieve highly comparable performance, with only marginal differences across evaluation metrics. This suggests that strong intrinsic spectral separability reduces sensitivity to the choice of loss function, allowing even simpler objectives to learn sufficiently discriminative embeddings. In Botswana and KSC, the performance gap between WCL and standard CL becomes relatively smaller, although WCL remains competitive or marginally superior. This behavior indicates that sparse and compact latent structures reduce the dependency on heavily guided contrastive weighting. Nevertheless, the consistent advantage of WCL demonstrates that MALNISI-guided weighting contributes positively across varying HSI characteristics.
blocks.zh: D类. 不同损失功能的影响:根据标准对比损失、重建损失、Triplet损失、Laplacian总差异损失和正统损失,对拟议加权对比损失的贡献进行审查。 使用WCL的改进在IndianP,PaviaU和HongHu中很明显,它在所有度量衡上都实现了更大的雷达覆盖(IndianP中的AA除外). 标准CL显示的性能相对较低,表明未加权正配对处理可能忽略了当地邻居的可靠性并引入了更弱的嵌入一致性. 其他损失情况更糟糕,表明仅保持重建忠心或执行双向边距不足以捕捉HSI数据中复杂的非线性多结构。 对萨利纳斯而言,所有方法都取得了高度可比较的性能,评价尺度之间只有微小的差异. 这表明,强烈的内在光谱分离会降低对损失功能选择的敏感性,使得更简单的目标能够充分学习歧视性嵌入. 在博茨瓦纳和苏格兰,世界劳联与标准CL之间的业绩差距较小,尽管世界劳联仍然具有竞争力或略高。 这种行为表明,稀疏而紧凑的潜在结构减少了对重定向对比加权的依赖. 尽管如此,世界劳联的一贯优势表明,由马来河流域工业分类指导的加权对不同工业分类特点作出了积极贡献。

blocks.en: E. Noise Sensitivity Analysis: Comparative radar visualization (Figure 7 ) of NMI under 6 6 noise types [ 48 ] : Gaussian, Salt and Pepper, Dead Pixels, Stripe, Impulse, and Mixed shows the proposed method’s lower noise sensitivity except on Salt and Pepper and Mixed. Salt and Pepper and Mixed noise produce the steepest NMI degradation, particularly for PaviaU, Botswana, and KSC at higher corruption levels ( 0.05 0.05 – 0.1 0.1 ). Salt and Pepper introduce many random extreme-valued perturbations distributed throughout the image, severely disturbing neighborhood consistency during graph construction, and as MALNISI relies on local neighborhood similarity, these noise levels lead to widespread corruptions and misleading adaptive weights. Mixed noise exhibits the strongest deterioration because it combines multiple corruption mechanisms. The degradation in dead pixels and impulse noise in certain cases, in spite of the noise being isolated, may locally affect MALNISI weighting, as they primarily disturb only a limited set of nodes whose values either become 0 0 or are degraded, respectively. Thus, rather than globally disrupting graph connectivity, the surrounding clean neighbors dominate, graph topology is largely preserved, and graph attention aggregation is able to further suppress unreliable isolated nodes, resulting in smaller performance degradation compared to salt and pepper noise.
blocks.zh: E. 噪声敏感度分析:6个噪声类型下NMI的比较雷达可视化(图7) [48]:高斯安、盐和辣椒、死像素、花纹、Impulse和Mixed显示除盐和辣椒和混合外拟议方法的低噪声敏感度。 盐和辣椒和混合噪音造成最陡峭的NMI退化,特别是对于博茨瓦纳的帕维亚乌和腐败程度较高的KSC而言(0.050.05 – 0.1 0.1)。 盐和辣椒引入了分布于整个图像中的许多随机的极端价值的扰动,在图表构建过程中严重地扰乱了街区的一致性,而由于MALNISI依赖于当地街区的相似性,这些噪音水平导致了普遍的腐败和误导性的适应性分量. 混合噪声表现出最严重的恶化,因为它结合了多种腐败机制。 死亡像素和冲动噪声在某些情况下的降解,尽管这些噪声被隔离,但可能会影响当地MALNISI的权重,因为这些噪声主要会干扰有限的一组节点,这些节点的数值要么变为0,要么已退化。 因此,与其在全球扰乱图的连通性,周边的清洁相邻者占据了主导地位,图的地貌基本保存了下来,而图的注意力集能能进一步压制不可靠的孤立节点,导致与盐和胡椒噪声相比性能退化较小.

blocks.en: F. Comparative Analysis of Unsupervised Traditional and Modern Feature Extraction Methods: Figure 8 compares the clustering performance of traditional and modern unsupervised embedding methods on 6 6 benchmark HSI datasets using NMI as the evaluation metric. Among the traditional feature extraction methods, including PCA, ICA, NMF, UMAP, and t-SNE, performance varies considerably across datasets. The proposed framework substantially outperforms all traditional methods on every dataset. A similar trend is observed when comparing against modern graph- and subspace-based embedding methods on all datasets except Botswana, where the performance is comparable to the strongest baseline, DSCFS. It is worth noting that not all modern methods report results on every benchmark dataset; therefore, some bars are absent in the figure. Overall, the proposed framework consistently achieves the best or highly competitive performance across all datasets, demonstrating its ability to learn discriminative representations that are well-suited for HSI clustering.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion & Scope For Future Works
blocks.zh: 六. 结论和未来工程的范围

blocks.en: The proposed framework does unsupervised segmentation of both well-separated/complex, compact/non-compact, and non-linear HSI data with improved performance. It accurately groups spatially distributed regions by simultaneously increasing inter-LULC discrimination and decreasing intra-LULC variations during latent space embedding. Extensive experiments validate the specific effectiveness of the three proposed modules in achieving this enhanced separability. The architecture also demonstrates strong robustness against spectral noise interference. Besides, the model consistently outperforms traditional and modern unsupervised feature extractors, which typically fail to capture the complex nonlinearities of hyperspectral data. Finally, the introduction of MALNISI provides significantly more reliable and context-aware graph weights compared to conventional spectral similarity indices, establishing a solid structural foundation for the network.
blocks.zh: 拟议框架对性能得到改进的高度分散/复杂、紧凑/非紧凑和非线性HSI数据进行无监督的分解。 它通过同时增加LULC之间的歧视和在潜在的空间嵌入过程中减少LULC内部的变化,准确地将空间分布区域分类。 广泛的实验验证了三个拟议单元在实现这种增强分离性方面的具体效力。 该建筑还表现出强烈的强力来对抗光谱噪声干扰. 此外,该模型的性能始终超过传统和现代的无监督特征提取器,它们通常无法捕捉到超光谱数据的复杂非线性. 最后,与常规光谱相似性指数相比,引入MALNISI提供了更可靠和了解上下文的图表权重,为网络奠定了坚实的结构基础.

blocks.en: Despite its strong performance, the proposed framework has some limitations. The learned representations depend on the quality of the constructed graph, making them sensitive to inaccurate neighborhood relationships. Moreover, graph construction requires predefined neighborhood parameters that may vary across datasets. The graph construction, weighted contrastive loss, and spectral clustering are computationally expensive for large hyperspectral scenes. Furthermore, the proposed framework does not explicitly address sparse data, limiting its effectiveness on datasets with sparse spatial distributions. Most hyperspectral image datasets also exhibit severe class imbalance, which degrades the clustering performance of minority classes. Future work will focus on developing mechanisms to effectively handle sparse data and class imbalance while enabling adaptive end-to-end graph learning with more robust graph-aware contrastive objectives and self-supervised learning to better exploit spectral–spatial information. Scalability can be improved through efficient graph sparsification, approximate spectral clustering, or hierarchical graph partitioning techniques. Finally, dynamic neighborhood modelling also offers promising directions for further advancing large-scale hyperspectral image clustering.
blocks.zh: 尽管拟议框架的业绩良好,但有一些局限性。 所学的表述取决于所构建的图表的质量,使其对不准确的邻里关系敏感. 此外,图表构建需要预先定义的相邻参数,这些参数可能因数据集而异. 图表构造、加权对比性损失和光谱集群对于大型高光谱场景来说计算成本很高。 此外,拟议框架没有明确涉及稀少的数据,限制了其在空间分布稀少的数据集方面的效力。 大多数超光谱成像数据集也表现出严重的阶级不平衡,这降低了少数群体阶层的集群性能. 未来的工作将侧重于建立有效处理数据稀少和班级失衡的机制,同时使适应性的端到端图学习具有更强的图感对比目标和自我监督的学习更好地利用光谱空间信息。 伸缩性可以通过高效的相图相接,相近光谱集成,或分级相图分化技术来改进. 最后,动态街区建模也为进一步推进大规模超光谱图像集群提供了有希望的方向.
